selection_basis: Wave 6 preserves the adopted two-range mode and prioritizes the under-covered law subject. Facilities/inspection has 20 verified questions against a target of 50, while storage/handling has 22 against a target of 60. Both have frozen READY e-Gov source paths and large remaining gaps; no third range is permitted in this wave.

batches.source_path: registered current e-Gov Act/Decree/Rule, emphasizing Rule Chapters 9 and 9-2 and other B6-unused facility/inspection procedure propositions
registered current e-Gov Decree/Rule Chapter 5 storage-and-handling provisions not already represented by B3

authoring_rule: Enumerate source-defined propositions first, collision-check against all 246 canonical/source-verified questions and the full Wave 6 peer set, and stop without backfill when materially distinct source-backed propositions are exhausted.
multi_source_rule: Each candidate binds to one registered source_id/version and one reproducible pinpoint locator. Cross-source answer-defining comparisons are prohibited without an approved source-bundle contract.
